messages:
taylor_peopleops: Quick heads-up — we've published an exception flow for the review window covering caregivers, parental leave returns, and hires with <6 months at comp. Please read and action if you have folks affected. link: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/exception-flow :sparkles:
leah_peopleops: TL;DR: managers can request a shortened review, extend the window by up to 2 weeks, or move someone into next cycle with notes. Use the form here: https://forms.redwood.com/review-exception
sam_manager: thanks! can we still give provisional feedback if someone is in "move to next cycle"?
taylor_peopleops: yes — please leave manager feedback in the form and in the employee's profile (People > Reviews > notes). It won’t affect calibration this cycle unless you request a provisional rating.
anita_engineering: scenario: new hire started 7/20, on track to be ramped but only 5 weeks. Best practice?
leah_peopleops: for hires <90 days, default is "defer to next cycle" unless manager asks for an early provisional. If you want an early review we need a short justification and the rubric evidence (see docs).
jamal_sre: what about contractors/vendors? do they get reviews here or via PMs?
taylor_peopleops: contractors: orgs should use the "vendor feedback" template (link in docs). If you want to include a contractor in calibration, file an exception and cc leah_peopleops.
sam_manager: how do I request an extension? I have two direct reports out on leave and can't finish before the deadline.
leah_peopleops: two options: 1) quick path — use the slash command /review-extend @employee <reason> which auto-routes to people ops for 48h triage. 2) full form (link above) if you need >2 weeks. Please include coverage plan.
taylor_peopleops: also FYI — calibration slots open next week. We prioritized late-afternoon slots to suit EU folks. Sign up: https://calendly.com/redwood-calibration
anita_engineering: If a manager is on parental leave, can reviews be reassigned to skip-level?
leah_peopleops: yes — reassign to skip-level or to an assigned backup manager. Please add the reassignment in the form and ping HR so we can update the workflow.
jamal_sre: any change to the form itself this cycle? I always get confused by the competencies section.
taylor_peopleops: small tweak: competencies are now 1–5 with a mandatory evidence sentence for any 1 or 2. We added an examples doc in the guide to speed writing. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/guide-examples
sam_manager: thanks, will use the examples. deadline reminder for managers?
leah_peopleops: manager completion due: 1938810000 (MM/DD/YY 11:59pm PT). Peer feedback closes 1938780000. Calibration week: 1938820000–1938850000. If you're blocked, file the /review-extend.
taylor_peopleops: quick checklist for managers (copy/paste):
```
- Confirm direct reports list in People > Team
- Collect peer feedback (send reminders)
- Fill manager section and attach evidence
- If hire <90d or on leave -> file exception form
- Sign up for a calibration slot
- Mark completed in the tracker
```
sam_manager: sharing that checklist in my team channel now :thumbsup:
leah_peopleops: if you run into weird edge cases (international parental leave, furloughs, long-term illness), ping us in DM or use the escalation box in the form. We’ll triage same day.
hr_bot: Reminder: performance-review-forms v3 was published and cached. If you see stale form data, clear browser cache or use incognito.
anita_engineering: one last Q — who fields appeals/questions after calibration?
taylor_peopleops: initial ask = manager -> people ops. If unresolved, it escalates to People Ops lead + manager's manager. We aim to resolve within 7 business days.
leah_peopleops: thanks everyone — leaning on managers to get exceptions in this week so calibration can run smoothly. Ping me or taylor_peopleops if you need help.
